backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining the report request system with types for urgency levels, statuses, and report requests. Implements functions to submit requests, retrieve all requests, and review requests with status updates.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting UI redesign features across multiple frontend components, mapping each feature to specific files, components, and test IDs with high confidence ratings.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend files describing enhanced UI components with improved styling, shadows, gradients, and visual hierarchy across the application.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a comprehensive design system using OKLCH color space for light and dark themes, including colors for backgrounds, borders, charts, and sidebar elements.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Report Request Portal application with a root div and module script reference to main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that wraps the application with RoleProvider context and renders the Layout component.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout component with sticky header featuring gradient logo, role toggle, tabbed navigation (Submit/View/Admin), and footer with attribution. Manages active tab state and conditional admin tab rendering.
frontend/src/components/ReportRequestFor: Comprehensive form component for submitting report requests with validation, multiple input types (text, textarea, select, checkbox), urgency level selection, data source dropdown, and success/error alerts with enhanced styling.
frontend/src/components/RequestDetailMod: Modal component for displaying and editing detailed report request information, including status updates, reviewer comments, and assignment functionality for admin users.
frontend/src/components/RequestsDashboar: Dashboard table component that displays all report requests with filtering, sorting, and action buttons to view details or review requests.
frontend/src/components/RoleToggle.tsx: UI component that displays the current user role (Admin or Requester) and provides a button to toggle between roles.
frontend/src/contexts/RoleContext.tsx: React context provider that manages user role state (Admin/Requester) and persists it to sessionStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages the Internet Computer actor instance based on the current identity, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Custom hook and provider for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching report requests, submitting new requests, and reviewing requests via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file with Tailwind directives and custom CSS variables defining a sophisticated slate-blue color palette for light and dark themes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboardPage.ts: Admin dashboard page component that displays the RequestsDashboard with header, description, and informational alert for admin users.
frontend/src/pages/SubmitRequestPage.tsx: Page component that renders the report request submission form with a header, icon, and card layout for creating new Power BI report requests.
frontend/src/pages/ViewRequestsPage.tsx: Page component that displays the requests dashboard with a header and card layout for viewing all submitted report requests and their statuses.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom theme extensions including OKLCH color system, typography settings, container queries, animations, and design tokens for the UI.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking the Report Request Portal application state, including architectural notes, existing features (form creation, approval workflow, dashboard, role simulation), and requirements mapping.
